Frequently Asked Questions

How do I place an order?

Add items to your cart, then click "Order via WhatsApp". Your order details will be sent to us automatically.

Do you deliver across Nigeria?

Yes! We deliver to all states in Nigeria. Delivery time varies by location.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept bank transfers and cash on delivery (where available). Details will be shared on WhatsApp after ordering.

Can I return a product?

Yes, we accept returns within 7 days if the product is faulty. Contact us on WhatsApp for assistance.
